slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Should the model allow selecting any of the seven listed foods (salmon, beef, pork, okra, carrots, celery, cabbage) in any non-negative amounts, or are the three meats (salmon, beef, pork) excluded from the dinner plan because they have no fiber data provided?
slot_scores.rationale: The question touched protein inclusion and whether any amounts are allowed, but it did not explicitly ask the exactly-one protein selection rule. The exact-one rule came from the user's volunteered answer.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or requirements for the dinner plan that I should know about, such as a maximum amount of any single food, a requirement to include at least one vegetable, or a limit on the number of different foods selected?
slot_scores.rationale: The question touched vegetable inclusion and other constraints, but it did not ask about the minimum number of vegetable types. The at-least-two-vegetables rule came from the user's answer.

stopping_behavior.rationale: By READY_TO_MODEL, both P1 hidden facts were stated by the user and clarified, so no P0/P1 fact remained unresolved at stopping. The agent's weak elicitation is reflected in the partial slot hits rather than in a premature stop.

summary: The agent asked many relevant modeling questions and confirmed all key constraints before declaring READY_TO_MODEL, but it recovered the protein-selection and vegetable-variety rules only through a broad catch-all and user-volunteered details rather than targeted questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
